(def ^:private tok-re
  #"[\s,]+|;[^\n]*|(\[|\]|\{|\}|"(?:\\.|[^"\\])*"|[^\s,\[\]{}]+)")

(defn tokens [s]
  (->> (re-seq tok-re s)
       (map (fn [m] (if (vector? m) (second m) nil)))
       (remove nil?)))

(defn atom-val [t]
  (cond
    (clojure.string/starts-with? t "\"")
    (-> (subs t 1 (dec (count t)))
        (clojure.string/replace "\\\"" "\"")
        (clojure.string/replace "\\\\" "\\"))
    (= t "true")  true
    (= t "false") false
    (= t "nil")   nil
    (clojure.string/starts-with? t ":") t
    :else
    (try (Long/parseLong t)
      (catch Exception _
        (try (Double/parseDouble t)
          (catch Exception _ t)))))}

;; iterator-based recursive descent reimplemented over a mutable token cursor (atom of seq)
(def end-marker ::end)

(defn parse-1 [cur]
  (let [t (first @cur)]
    (swap! cur rest)
    (cond
      (= t "[")
      (loop [out []]
        (let [x (parse-1 cur)]
          (if (= x end-marker) out (recur (conj out x)))))
      (= t "{")
      (loop [out {}]
        (let [k (parse-1 cur)]
          (if (= k end-marker) out
            (let [v (parse-1 cur)]
              (recur (assoc out k v))))))
      (or (= t "]") (= t "}")) end-marker
      :else (atom-val t))))

(defn load-graph [path]
  (let [forms (read-edn (slurp path))]
    (reduce
      (fn [[nodes edges] f]
        (cond
          (not (map? f)) [nodes edges]
          (contains? f ":lt/id") [(assoc nodes (get f ":lt/id") f) edges]
          (and (contains? f ":en/from") (contains? f ":en/to")) [nodes (conj edges f)]
          :else [nodes edges]))
      [{} []]
      forms)))

(def optionality-weight {":mandatory" 1.0 ":recommended" 0.6 ":optional" 0.3})
(def cite-kinds #{":cites-statute" ":mandated-by"})
(def has-clause-kinds #{":has-clause"})
(def instantiate-kinds #{":instantiates"})
(def govern-kinds #{":governed-by" ":applies-in"})

(defn analyze [nodes edges]
  (let [clause-templates
        (reduce (fn [m e]
                  (if (contains? has-clause-kinds (get e ":en/kind"))
                    (update m (get e ":en/to") (fnil conj []) (get e ":en/from"))
                    m))
                {} edges)
        opt-weight (fn [clause-id]
                     (get optionality-weight
                          (get (get nodes clause-id {}) ":clause/optionality") 0.6))]
    (reduce
      (fn [acc e]
        (let [kind (get e ":en/kind")
              load- (let [v (get e ":en/binding-load" 0.0)] (double (or v 0.0)))
              src (get e ":en/from")
              dst (get e ":en/to")]
          (cond
            (contains? cite-kinds kind)
            (let [acc (update-in acc [:statute_pull dst] (fnil + 0.0) load-)
                  src-kind (get (get nodes src {}) ":lt/kind")]
              (cond
                (= src-kind ":clause")
                (let [w (opt-weight src)]
                  (reduce (fn [a tmpl]
                            (update-in a [:grounded tmpl] (fnil + 0.0) (* load- w)))
                          acc (get clause-templates src [])))
                (= src-kind ":template")
                (update-in acc [:grounded src] (fnil + 0.0) load-)
                :else acc))
            (contains? has-clause-kinds kind)
            (update-in acc [:reuse dst] (fnil + 0.0) load-)
            (contains? govern-kinds kind)
            (update-in acc [:juris_reach src] (fnil + 0.0) load-)
            (contains? instantiate-kinds kind)
            (update-in acc [:concept_reach dst] (fnil + 0.0) load-)
            :else acc)))
      {:grounded {} :reuse {} :statute_pull {} :juris_reach {} :concept_reach {}}
      edges)))
